bonuses.name: Champion
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 3 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: 'Ere We Go!
bonuses.text: If this Threat is Engaged at the start of its Turn, it gains +2 damage to melee attacks.

abilities.name: I'm Da Boss!
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin. All allies with the ORK Keyword within 10 metres gain +2 bonus dice to Weapon Skill (I) Tests.

abilities.name: Orks Is Never Defeated
abilities.text: Whenever a Threat with the ORK Keyword dies within 10 metres of the Ork Nob, the Nob may sacrifice 1 Shock. If it does, the ORK Threat may make an immediate attack before it dies.

options.name: Meganobz
options.text: What's bigger, fightier, and shootier than an Ork Nob? A Nob in Mega-Armour — a Meganob! Ork Meganobz often lead other Nobz and mobs of Boyz into battle. Meganobz use the same statistics as Nobz, with the following adjustments: SKILLS: Strength 10, Resilience 15, Speed 6 (May not Run or Sprint)
